newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Heaven buys 60 pct of U.S. firm.
newsitem.headline: Heaven buys 60 pct of U.S. firm.

text.p: Confectionary retailer Sweets from Heaven Holdings Ltd announced on Thursday it had bought an effective 60 percent stake of U.S.-based Candy Headquarters Inc for an undisclosed sum.
The company said in a statement that the deal, which had Reserve Bank approval, could result in up to 125 outlets being opened in the U.S. market by the end of the decade.
In terms of the deal, effective from February 28, Heaven had bought 60 percent of a limited partnership, with the owners of Candy Headquarters holding the balance.
"The partnership will, in turn, acquire the business and assets of Candy Headquarters including goodwill," the company said in a statement.
The deal was unlikely to have a material effect on either earnings or asset value in the short-term, but was expected to contribute significantly to earnings in the longer term.

Candy Headquarters, which operates through 28 franchised and two company-owned confectionery stores, would be renamed Heaven USA and the entire management of Candy Headquarters would move to Heaven USA.

"This deal offers Heaven USA access to key retail sites in the U.S., the opportunity to expand into the world's largest market with our proven formula and experienced local management and the prospect of substantial exports of our products through a franchise network that is expected to expand significantly," Heaven chief executive Laurie Davidoff said.
